# healthviz

> A playground of interactive visualisations built on open European health data. Each entry takes one question and the public data to answer it. Entries are dated snapshots of public data; each page states when its data was retrieved and when the source last updated it.

## Entries

- [Will your doctor retire soon?](https://healthviz.eu/retiring-doctors/): Doctors by age and sex for 33 countries in Europe (2024), with the share aged 55 or over and medical graduates per year (2022-2024) against the doctors aged 55 or over. In 2024 the share of doctors aged 55 or over ranged from 19% in Portugal to 55% in Bulgaria. Most countries count practising doctors; the page flags those that count professionally active or licensed doctors. Source: Eurostat hlth_rs_phys, hlth_rs_grd2 and hlth_rs_prs2, retrieved 2026-11-01; licence CC BY 4.0. Data as CSV: https://healthviz.eu/retiring-doctors/data.csv
- [When does Europe retire, and how many healthy years are left at 65?](https://healthviz.eu/healthy-retirement/): Healthy life years and life expectancy at 65 for 28 countries in Europe (2024), for women, men and in total, next to the average age at which people aged 65-74 started their old-age pension (2023). In 2024 healthy years at 65 ranged from 4.2 in Latvia to 14.2 in Sweden; EU-27 10.3 healthy years of 20.2 remaining. Source: Eurostat hlth_hlye and lfso_23pens03, retrieved 2026-10-27; licence CC BY 4.0. Data as CSV: https://healthviz.eu/healthy-retirement/data.csv
- [How much does Europe spend on health, and who pays?](https://healthviz.eu/health-spending/): Current health expenditure for 34 countries in Europe, 2016–2024: per person (PPS and euro), as % of GDP, by who pays (government and compulsory insurance, voluntary insurance, out of pocket) and by function (treatment, long-term care, medicines, lab and transport, administration, prevention), as shares and PPS per person. In 2024 spending per person ranged from 1,969 PPS in Romania to 5,791 PPS in Germany; the EU-27 average was 4,075 PPS. Source: Eurostat hlth_sha11_hf and hlth_sha11_hc, last updated by Eurostat 2026-10-23, retrieved 2026-10-26; licence CC BY 4.0. Data as CSV: https://healthviz.eu/health-spending/data.csv
- [Where in Europe do people live longest?](https://healthviz.eu/life-expectancy/): Life expectancy at birth for 292 regions in Europe (NUTS 2), 2002–2023, for women, men and in total, with the EU-27 average and national values. In 2023 (total, EU-27) it ranged from 73.9 years in Severozapaden (Bulgaria) to 86.1 years in Comunidad de Madrid (Spain); the EU-27 average was 81.4. Source: Eurostat demo_r_mlifexp and demo_mlexpec, last updated by Eurostat 2025-06-05, retrieved 2026-10-26; licence CC BY 4.0. Data as CSV: https://healthviz.eu/life-expectancy/data.csv
